name: Triage Improvement Suggestion
description: Investigate a fleet agent's improvement suggestion, classify it into the 9-module tiered set, and execute the right improvement process. REPO modules land via repo-improvement skill (scan + PR); LOCAL modules land via local-improvement skill (Firestore/overlay, no PR).

steps.title: Read suggestion and mission history
steps.description: Read the improvement suggestion from the delegation instruction. Extract the referenced mission ID. Using work-management skill, read the referenced mission's full work tree — all M/C/T envelopes, their statuses, outputs, verdicts, iteration counts, and telemetry entries. Understand: what the mission tried to do, what succeeded, what failed, how many envelopes were created, and how long it took.
steps.accept_criteria: Written summary: what the mission did, what went wrong or was suboptimal, what the user specifically suggested, and the mission's key metrics (envelope count, duration, failure points).

steps.title: Classify into improvement module(s)
steps.description: Based on the evidence, classify the improvement into one or more of the 9 modules. Read the architect-prime project context for module definitions. The 9 modules are: REPO modules — (1) Daemons (p-improve-daemons) — control flow bug, crash, stuck loop, ceremony divergence. (2) Organ SOULs (p-improve-souls) — bad decisions, plan inflation, false verdicts, wrong agent assignments. (3) Neural Gateway (p-improve-gateway) — high token cost, low cache rate, loop guard issues. (4) Skills (p-improve-skills) — missing procedures, wrong syntax, low success rate. (5) Dashboard & Bootstrap (p-improve-dashboard) — missing UI features, deployment friction. (6) Context & Memory Machinery (p-improve-context-repo) — context loading code, memory retrieval, consolidation logic. (7) Platform Processes (p-improve-work-layer-repo) — generic process coverage, bad process steps. LOCAL modules — (8) Context & Memory Content (p-improve-context-local) — stale/missing project context, wrong facts, memory content. (9) Operator Processes (p-improve-work-layer-local) — operator/ process improvements, custom workflow gaps. Delegation is not a module. Route a delegation finding to its owning module: governance/guards/timeouts/cross-agent publish → p-improve-daemons; vague instruction quality → p-improve-souls; delegation as a process step → p-improve-work-layer-repo (generic) or p-improve-work-layer-local (operator); operator-specific delegation pattern → p-improve-context-local. A single finding never mixes tiers — split it (generic skeleton via the REPO process; operator values via the LOCAL process). Report the module(s) and the specific finding for each.
steps.accept_criteria: At least one module identified with specific evidence and its tier (REPO or LOCAL). If multiple modules, they are prioritized by impact. Each finding is assigned to exactly one tier.

steps.title: Execute improvement process(es)
steps.description: For each identified module, follow the corresponding improvement process. REPO modules: the process's land step uses the repo-improvement skill (contamination scan + PR to main). LOCAL modules: the process's land step uses the local-improvement skill (Firestore/overlay, no PR). Keep each module's changes separate (one module per commit).
steps.accept_criteria: Improvement executed per the process. REPO changes landed via repo-improvement skill with clean scan. LOCAL changes landed via local-improvement skill with no platform files touched.

steps.title: Report back
steps.description: Compose a summary for the fleet agent's delegation result: what the user suggested, what was investigated, what was improved (noting tier: REPO PR or LOCAL persist), what the user should expect to see differently. Keep it concise — the user is not an engineer.
steps.accept_criteria: Summary delivered via delegation result. Understandable without reading the PR.
